answer: Each epoch a random sample of answer pairs is handed to jurors who flag near-duplicates. If two answers from different keys mirror each other beyond a set similarity threshold, both lose that epoch's reward and forfeit a 30-POA bond. A farm posting templated clones is its own worst enemy: with K near-identical answers the chance at least one sampled pair is caught and voided climbs toward 1 as K grows, so the 500th clone is far likelier to sink the batch than the 5th. Honest distinct work is a pearl that passes; a farm's fleet runs aground at the jetty.
